Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/Marrickville/Marrickville DCP 2011 - 2 11 Fencing.pdf

Clause N/A - heritage (development_control): NB Specific detail for fencing in heritage conservation areas  (HCAs)  is provided in Part 8 (Heritage) of this  DCP.

Clause C4 - heritage (development_control): Modifications to the fence of a heritage item, period building or within a  heritage conservation area  must be designed in a  manner which contributes to the historic style of the bui lding and streetscape context.

Clause C5 - heritage (development_control): Existing fences must  be retained where they are consistent with the period style of the building .

Clause C6 - heritage (development_control): Any new fences must  be consistent with the traditional designs used in the area, but using simpler detailing

Clause C12 - height_limit (development_control): Fences over 1.2 m etres  high  are generally inappropriate as they reduce visibility of the garden setting and the heritage item or period b uilding.

Clause C12 - height_limit (development_control): On sloping sites, fences may rise to a m aximum 1.5  metres  before stepping down to 1.2  metres or less.

Clause C13 - other (development_control): High solid walls and fences must be avoided as they d etract from the streetscape and impede passive su rveillance.

Clause C14 - other (development_control): New fences must  be finished in dark or recessive materials and surfaces , and aluminium panel fencing must be avoided.
